caption: The drawing shows a black, rectangular cabinet with four visible legs. The front panel of the cabinet is decorated with a symmetrical floral design featuring a stylized central green stem with two curved branches and two large red heart-shaped leaves or petals situated below a multicolored flower at the top, which has white, green, and red segments. The floral motif is contained within a rectangular frame bordered by a wavy, cream-colored line. The background behind the cabinet is plain and beige, and the cabinet is centered on the page.
title: Side View of Guilford Painted Chest
